description.value: Edo Japan is a Canadian fast-food chain with over 200 locations, specializing in Japanese teppanyaki-style grilled meals including teriyaki bowls, stir-fry noodles, and combos cooked fresh on the grill. Founded in Calgary in 1979, it is a recognizable chain stop on Kelowna's busy Harvey Avenue commercial corridor. The location is takeout-focused with no drive-through, making it a practical quick-meal stop for cyclists passing through the area.
